intro: Agent panel to take, make and transfer calls. IVR asks the caller type and problem first. CRM view, call history, dropped-call tracking, tickets, after-hours recordings, scheduling and an admin dashboard.
Part of Spectrum’s [AI Contact Center](service:ai-contact-center): take the whole seven-part system, or only the parts you need. Every part shares one customer record.

sections.title: What it fixes

items.text: Callers wait in a queue for the next free agent.
Agents search the customer record by hand while the caller waits.
Tickets and summaries are written by hand after the call.
Nobody can easily see why people are calling.

after: With the call centre connected to the AI parts, routine contacts are answered automatically and agents get the cases that need a person, with a full summary on screen.
